Video from Coursera course I and Dr. Çetinkaya-Rundel created to help teach Quarto (fancy R-markdown)!

Note: The mp4 was to large to embed onto our GitHub website. 

Please see the Moodle link [here](https://moodle-courses2527.wolfware.ncsu.edu/mod/page/view.php?id=1603737)


To be able to compile PDFs, you will also need to download TinyTex. You can do so by running the following code in your Console.

```         
tinytex::install_tinytex()
```

Note: If you are on a Mac, you already have this!
